thread:
Sam (sales): Quick sync — BigBank POC wants private VPC + least-priv access. They refuse long-lived shared API keys. Need a recommended flow and rough pricing delta vs hosted. Any blockers?
Aisha (solutions): Ok. Recommend ephemeral service-account keys + SCIM SSO or short-lived API keys. For Private we can integrate KMS/HSM and IP allowlist.
Priya (eng): +1. Also need workload numbers to size Dedicated pool or Private infra. Peak RPS, tokens per call, seq len, steady vs burst.
Sam (sales): They gave roughs: peak ~60 rps, ~150 tokens avg, occasional 500-token analysis jobs. SLA request 99.9.
Marco (security): For enterprise/legal: require audit log retention 12 months, KMS with customer-managed keys, and RBAC roles with least privilege. No admin for contractors. Also ask whether SCIM provisioning available.
Aisha (solutions): SCIM is supported for our Private offering. For Hosted we can do SSO + SCIM for workspace invites, but keys are still tenant-managed. For POC, propose: 1) Private VPC with customer KMS, 2) ephemeral scoped keys for POC engineers, 3) explicit roles: poc-viewer, poc-engineer, poc-admin (very limited), billing only via Jordan.
Jordan (acctmgmt): Pricing note: Private + KMS + dedicated nodes adds a setup fee and higher commit. For rough ballpark: small Dedicated pool equivalent (8x A100) start ~$12k/mo committed; Private infra plus KMS & audit add ~+$3k/mo and one-time onboarding fee. Precise quote depends on GPU type and region.
Priya (eng): Lead time: Dedicated pool provisioning ~3 business days after contract and capacity approval. Private VPC onboarding with KMS + networking typically 7-10 business days (troubleshoot routes, NAT, peering).
Sam (sales): They asked about key rotation during the POC (2 weeks). Can we issue rotating keys automatically?
Aisha (solutions): Yes — we can create short-lived API keys (token TTL 1h/8h) tied to a service account. We can also issue an ephemeral key via a small management endpoint. Suggest dev team use SDK flow to fetch on each session.
Marco (security): For audit/auditability: ensure keys are traceable to a named user/service account, not a shared key. Logs should include request_id, model, tokens_in/out, and principal. We should confirm retention & export formats (syslog/s3).
Sam (sales): Can someone drop a minimal POC request payload we can send to BigBank security?
Priya (eng): Sure — paste below:
```
POC request:
customer: BigBank Corp
env: Private VPC
region: us-east-1
peak_rps: 60
avg_tokens: 150
burst_max_tokens: 500
required_sla: 99.9
kms: customer-managed (AWS KMS)
scim: required
audit_retention_days: 365
roles_needed: [poc-viewer, poc-engineer, poc-admin]
rotation: short-lived keys (TTL 8h) + audit logging
```
Aisha (solutions): I'll attach that to the security packet. Also propose fallback: if Private onboarding slips, fallback to Dedicated pool + allowlist IP + strict scoped API keys for lower friction.
Sam (sales): Perfect. One more — billing access for POC team? They want to prevent engineers from seeing invoices. Can we scope billing separately?
Jordan (acctmgmt): Yes — billing is separate role; we can create a billing-only account. Engineers get no billing privileges.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: DPOOL-4821 "BigBank POC - Private VPC onboarding & ephemeral keys" assigned to eng-infra. ETA fields updated.
Marco (security): Also flag: ensure SSO sessions expire <= 24h during POC and JIT elevation for poc-admin.
Aisha (solutions): I'll coordinate with eng on the ticket and send a consolidated checklist to BigBank sec later today :thumbsup:
Sam (sales): Thanks all — will send to BigBank and loop back once they confirm.
